layers.name: Elevation (LOLA)
layers.description: Mean surface height in each H3 cell relative to the 1737.4 km lunar reference sphere, from the LOLA LDEM 16 pixels/degree global grid (≈1.9 km pixels).
layers.rangeMethod: 1st and 99th percentiles of the res-5 cell means, rounded outward to 10 m
limitations: 16 pixels/degree grid (≈1.9 km pixels at the equator): values exist down to H3 resolution 5 only (~19 km² cells, about 5 pixels each near the equator); resolution-6 cells inherit their res-5 parent's value.
Heights are relative to the 1737.4 km reference sphere (planetary radius − 1737.4 km), not a geoid or equipotential surface.
Display/demo product: far too coarse for slopes, roughness or landing-site work. Use SLDEM2015 (MOON-TOPO-01, 59 m, ±60°) or LOLA LDEM 128 ppd (237 m) for slopes.
Gaps between LOLA ground tracks are interpolated by the producer (GMT 'surface'); the label warns of possible edge artifacts at the 45° latitude band boundaries.
Pixel-centre assignment; cell values are pixel-area-weighted (cos latitude) means, and parent cells are area-weighted means of all their pixels.
